description.text:
The Sun & Moon Trainer Kit: Lycanroc & Alolan Raichu, released on 21 April 2017 as the first kit of the Sun & Moon Series, held two 30-card half decks with two Trainer Kit Guides that take players through eight turns, a deck box, a playmat, counters and an Alolan Raichu coin. Most cards are reprints from other expansions, but Lycanroc, Alolan Raichu, Pikachu, Fletchling and Fletchinder are new. All carry the kit's own set symbol and no rarity mark, numbered in the order each guide's game draws them. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the kit's code unlocked the two halves combined as the Midnight Surfer theme deck.

The Alolan Raichu half deck plays Lightning Pokémon and runs on Lightning and Psychic Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: Sun & Moon Trainer Kit: Lycanroc & Alolan Raichu (TCG) (Wayback Machine copy, 26 June 2026)
